ai_summary: Deutsche Bank AG, acting as a security agent, has disclosed the refinancing of a loan facility for Endeavour Trade and Investment Ltd, which continues to secure an existing encumbrance of 56.69% of ACC Limited's shares. This transaction does not change the number of ACC shares under encumbrance; rather, it extends the benefit of the existing security to new lenders for the refinanced debt. While not a new encumbrance, the ongoing pledging of a majority stake in ACC Limited, held through a complex structure of intermediary entities, signifies potential control shifts if the borrower defaults.
